question: Among the patients whose creatinine level is abnormal, how many of them aren't 70 yet?
evidence: creatinine level is abnormal refers to CRE >= 1.5; aren't 70 yet refers to SUBTRACT((YEAR(CURDATE()), YEAR(Birthday))) < 70;
clarification: Count every row, including repeated ID values.
gold: SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND STRFTIME('%Y', DATE('now')) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) < 70
gold0: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND STRFTIME('%Y', Date('now')) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) < 70

c.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5 AND YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(p.Birthday) < 70;

b.request: Count the Laboratory rows with CRE ≥ 1.5 whose linked patient’s current year minus birth year is less than 70, counting repeated patient IDs separately
b.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5 AND CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 70

d.request: How many patient rows have CRE >= 1.5 and YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(Birthday) < 70, counting rows with repeated ID values separately?
d.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5 AND YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(p.Birthday) < 70;
